title: Akiyama Mizuki — Don't Be Scared〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I like the expressions we have on our faces in this picture! And the illuminations in this one are good too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Mafuyu's completely deadpan in this one...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu didn't really seem to enjoy herself much in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I suppose there wasn't much we could do since her mind was focused on skipping her practice exam and what her mom was going to think.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If we get another chance to go again, I want her to genuinely have fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I've fiddled with these photos long enough, so it's phone call time♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<Thank you for calling!
This is Rui Kamishiro, the director of Wonderlands×Showtime.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Lightning, explosions and pop-up devices are my forte. Indoors or out, I guarantee to bring you the greatest show imaginable. What sort of production do you have in mind?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is it supposed to be your Wonderlands×Showtime sales pitch?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <No, I decided to throw you a curveball since it's so rare for you to call me like this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, you came up with that on the spot? Nice.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe. Anyway, how can I help you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wanted to thank you for those tickets! I really appreciate you giving them to me and everybody in my group really enjoyed our little trip.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, you were there to see our show, no? I wish I could've gone to greet you all, but we had to do the night show...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. It was super fun!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah! She's doing cartwheels so fast!
Back to back too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, Otori's in the gymnastics club...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That explains why she's so good at doing cartwheels.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
She's in the dance and swimming clubs too...
And apparently, she helps with the softball team from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That girl from Miya Girls and that childhood friend of yours were really cute and cool too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, I thought Tsukasa was supposed to be the protagonist in all your shows, but I was surprised to see that wasn't the case.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Yes, he's the face of our troupe, but we're always looking to use new ideas and variations in our shows.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that reminds me! The girl who did all those amazing cartwheels! I remember meeting her once before!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I decided to try and talk to her because I thought her fashion sense was kind of interesting, but I had no idea that she was your friend, Rui...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe. Emu occasionally visits our school, so you may actually get another chance to see her.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <By the way, she was wondering if her senior had fun. Do you know if they did?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <I think she spotted them during the night show but couldn't get a clear look at their face.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, Mafuyu... Oh, her senior...
She was there after dealing with some personal troubles.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Normally, she'd never get so disoriented, but she was really distraught by what had happened...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was a little bummed out by that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, I'm hoping when we go next time that it'll be under better circumstances and we can all have fun.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe. Then, we'll need to get ready by putting a nice polish on our shows.>
